name: FLUX 3 Image
description: Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Image: instruction edits of the crop with up to nine more pictures, new images from the prompt with up to ten reference images. Adapter written from the provider's docs (2026-10-01). Also on OpenRouter. Also on Comfy Router. Also on fal.ai. Also on Oxen.ai.

bfl.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. The crop is image 1, then the Original and the reference layers (image 2 ..), ten pictures at most, each at least 256 px a side. The crop is widened to one of the model's 15 aspect presets; the size is a tier picked from the crop (1k about 1 MP, 2k about 4 MP). There is no seed, so two runs differ, and the model expands the prompt itself. Grounding lets it search the web and images for the prompt before it renders. The Boxes switch under the prompt sends the document's boxes as bounding boxes in the prompt, or the selection as one box when there are none (a New row with the prompt as its description; with an @img token, that reference placed in the box), so the model puts the change where the box is. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

fal.note: Runs on fal.ai under Black Forest Labs' own name there (blackforestlabs/flux-3); written from fal's docs and schema (2026-10-02), not run against the live API yet. The pictures go inline in the request. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. The crop is image 1, then the Original and the reference layers (image 2 ..), ten pictures at most, each 256 px a side to 4 MP on fal (a smaller or larger reference layer is scaled, the crop is held to 4 MP). The crop is widened to one of fal's 14 aspect presets (no 9:21) and sent as that shape; the size is a tier picked from the crop's area (1k about 1 MP, 2k about 4 MP). There is no seed, so two runs differ. Prompt expansion lets the model rewrite the prompt before it renders, as Black Forest Labs' own API always does; fal's default is off. Grounding (web and image search) cannot be set here. The Boxes switch under the prompt sends the document's boxes as bounding boxes in the prompt, as on Black Forest Labs' own API. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

The pictures go inline (data URLs, which Oxen's docs allow but do not recommend for production) in the request to Oxen.ai, which passes them to Black Forest Labs; Oxen keeps every generated image in your Oxen account.
